svg.title: current internal api topology
svg.desc: Top-to-bottom trust zones, logical endpoints and role instances. Communication planes are listed explicitly to avoid ambiguous crossing connections. Physical placement is stated separately.

g.text: Private API composition: one internal listener per role
Historical role layout from the 2026-11-10 lanes • source-scoped architecture example
HISTORICAL STRUCTURE | serve.internal per role; current source and acceptance are in the release records
Network reachability and application authority are separate
Browsers, apps, uploaders and owner/operator clients
Only nginx is host-published by the synthetic Compose binding
nginx already handles HTTP proxying and WebSocket upgrade/tunnel
Routes consumer API / UI / Socket.IO; publishes no internal listener, admin plane or owner management port
Consumer/management HTTP is separate from the internal listener
One serve.internal per process; role code fixes its contracts
Network only when NS_SERVE_INTERNAL_HOST and _PORT are both set; no authentication of its own
Peers are dialled at NS_<ROLE>_INTERNAL_URL or _SOCKET; configuration cannot move or merge contracts
SIGTERM: stop accepting, finish in-flight calls up to the deadline (5 s default), then force-close
A force-closed call stays uncertain for its caller
REFERENCE: the Compose demo binds /run/ns-ipc/<role>.sock for every role; socket files carry HTTP, not a separate protocol.
The admin listener may share the API address on another port; never every interface; non-loopback needs an explicit acknowledgement.
Role-scoped authority is unchanged by listener or transport choice
Communication planes — exact bindings, separate from placement
Reference HTTP routing and WebSocket upgrade. Realtime still owns application
protocol, subscriptions, fanout and exact message authorization.
alarm-delivery (deliverAlarm). The output revision changes only on content change,
which wakes the consumer; an active, unacknowledged alarm repeats on the tenant
authorized writes/ACKs. Delivery can itself check recipient authority.
callable for a paused or suspended tenant. Exact roster, actual incarnation and
ownership-operations (list, add, transfer, recover), refused unless the tenant is
active. The restore census exempts the ownership_operator identity because it
holds no clinical or counter-write grant.
Paused: uploads stored, reads/UI 423 TENANT_PAUSED, evaluator stopped, sockets
disconnected. Suspended: everything 423 TENANT_SUSPENDED, sockets disconnected.
Socket default under a 0700 runtime directory; host/port needs explicit network
trust. Service/version headers identify contracts, not credentials.
Historical source scope only; consult release records for current acceptance and deployment qualification.
Evidence: reports/tenancy/internal-listener-2026-11-10/README.md and admin-lifecycle-2026-11-10/; diagram is a read-derived view.
